title: getBaseConfiguration resolves Object.prototype keys as standards, crashing filesize() for standard: 'constructor'
property: any standard string other than si/iec/jedec falls back to the base-driven default configuration
property_test: base config for unknown standard falls back by base
expected: { isDecimal: true, ceil: 1000, actualStandard: 'jedec' } (the default fallback used for any unknown standard)
actual: returns the inherited Object function (truthy lookup on a plain object literal); filesize(1000, {standard:'constructor'}) throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'bytes') in resolveSymbol
evidence: STANDARD_CONFIGS is a plain object, so `STANDARD_CONFIGS[standard]` finds inherited keys (constructor, toString, __proto__, hasOwnProperty). The function's code path explicitly falls back to base/default for unrecognised standards (e.g. 'foo' works), so a string like 'constructor' should behave the same instead of crashing; AGENTS.md also lists prototype-related access as a forbidden pattern.
